title: refactor(objectql): move the migration-flag and attestation bodies out of engine.ts into engine-migration-flags.ts (#25522 cut 13)
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XAdqJmXbzB3BaxdJyTaKQQW)_
Part of #25522
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：把 `engine.ts` 里「迁移标志与证明」一段的 8 个方法体原样搬进新文件 `engine-migration-flags.ts`，类上方法签名与注释不变，只把方法体换成转交；顺手改正第 12 刀留下的两处过时说明（一行文件头注释、一个 ADR 锚条目）。`engine.ts` 22,517 → 22,423 行。
- **为什么改**：#25522 按缝拆分 `engine.ts` 的第 13 刀；本段在刀前重测的缝表里净减行最多，且不与在途 PR 重叠。席位为本刀裁定了「宿主 setter」：被搬方法体写入的类字段，经宿主上的一对 get/set 访问器写回实例。
- **风险与回滚**：纯搬移，无行为变化；公开 `.d.ts` 六个文件逐字节不变；setter 的读写回实例由一次性探针在新旧两版上逐行对照证明。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 里 `announceOpenMigrationGates` 的转交桩（唯一带 setter 的一处）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-migration-flags.ts`（搬入的方法体与 `MigrationFlagsHost`）、`scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__engine-execute-transactions.ts.json`（锚段落去掉重复的一半）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`，应见 472 个测试文件全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

Cut 13 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6430872749`, which carries the seat's host-setter ruling for this cut. Eight bodies of the "Migration flags and attestations" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-migration-flags.ts`: `supplyTenantKeyCertifiedResolver` (hand a driver the "is this database certified" question), `isOrganizationOwnershipCertified` (its answer), `readFileReferencesFlagRow` and `isValueShapesMigrationVerified` (the two memoized flag readers), `readMigrationFlagVerified` (the one `sys_migration` row read behind them), `noteAdmittedValueShapeViolation` (tally a violation this boot admitted), `announceOpenMigrationGates` (the once-per-boot open-gate advisory) and `wasDatastoreCreatedFromEmpty`. Two stale path readers of cut 12 are corrected in the same PR. No behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-9q75rj` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `756220c4a`, which contains cut 12's merge (`2e7127bc3a`, #26371). Nothing was edited before that merge landed: the move was dry-run on #26371's head while it was in the queue, and the four files committed here are byte-identical to that dry run (`git hash-object`, 4 of 4; `engine.ts` at `756220c4a` is the same blob, `a17c9e9b93e6`, as at #26371's head).

## What changes

Nine members of the section stay: `isFileReferencesMigrationVerified` (ADR-0104 names it by path), `recordObservedDeviation` and `retractCreationAttestation` (each writes through `this.update`, a self-call the screen keeps in the class), and six bodies too short to pay for a host (`haveFileColumnsMoved`, `readMigrationFlagMemoized`, `readMigrationFlagRowMemoized`, `valueShapeViolationsAdmitted`, `admittedViolationSink`, `invalidateDataMigrationFlags`). Every field of the section stays declared where it was.

### The shape

- The class keeps all eight methods with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one host literal of exactly the `MigrationFlagsHost` members it reads, plus a `.call`, marked `[#25522 cut 13]`, as cuts 8, 10, 11 and 12 did. Fields go as getters over a `readX` closure (`logger`, `_registry`, `admittedValueShapeViolations`, `drivers`); methods go as late-bound closures (`isOrganizationOwnershipCertified`, `findOne`, `readMigrationFlagRowMemoized`, `readMigrationFlagMemoized`, `recordObservedDeviation`, `retractCreationAttestation`, `objectHasMediaField`, `objectHasCoveredValueField`, `readMigrationFlagVerified`), so a spy or double set on the engine is still the one a call reaches.
- **The setter (seat ruling for this cut).** `announceOpenMigrationGates` is the one moved body that ASSIGNS a field (`this.migrationGatesAnnounced = true`). Its host carries the accessor pair `get migrationGatesAnnounced() { return readMigrationGatesAnnounced(); }, set migrationGatesAnnounced(v) { writeMigrationGatesAnnounced(v); }`, where `writeMigrationGatesAnnounced = (v: ObjectQL['migrationGatesAnnounced']) => { this.migrationGatesAnnounced = v; }` closes over the instance as the getters' `readX` do. The field stays declared on the class with its initialiser and modifiers untouched; `MigrationFlagsHost` types it `migrationGatesAnnounced: ObjectQL['migrationGatesAnnounced']`, not `readonly`. No other moved body assigns a field, so no other setter exists (`noteAdmittedValueShapeViolation` calls `.set` on the `admittedValueShapeViolations` map it reads; that is a read of the field).
- **One named host.** `MigrationFlagsHost` types each member as the class member (`ObjectQL['logger']` and so on); each function's `this` is the `Pick` of what it reads. The module imports the engine only as a type.
- **One type gains `export`.** `MigrationFlagRead` (the shape of one `sys_migration` flag read) is the return type of two moved bodies and of members that stay. It stays declared in `engine.ts`, byte for byte, and gains `export` in place so the module can name it with `import type`; no second copy, and no runtime import of `engine.ts`. `index.ts` names its exports singly, so the published `.d.ts` does not move (below).
- **Imports.** The module imports `DATA_MIGRATION_FLAG_OBJECT`, the three migration ids, `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_SHAPE_GENERATION`, `organizationOwnershipShapeGenerationOf`, `isDataMigrationFlagVerified` and `hasMovedFileColumns` (`@objectstack/spec/system`), `ExecutionContext` (type), `IDataDriver` (type, `@objectstack/core`), `isMissingTableError`, `valueShapePostureSetByEnv`, `mediaPostureSetByEnv` and the type `AdmittedValueShapeViolation`. `engine.ts` drops `VALUE_SHAPES_MIGRATION_ID`, `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_MIGRATION_ID`, `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_SHAPE_GENERATION`, `organizationOwnershipShapeGenerationOf`, `hasMovedFileColumns`, `valueShapePostureSetByEnv` and `mediaPostureSetByEnv`, whose last code readers moved (`hasMovedFileColumns` is still named in a docblock that stays), and gains the module import with a three-line comment.
- The module header names what moved, what stays and why, and names ADR-0104 and ADR-0131 without a decision letter.

### Net lines (the seat's rule)

`engine.ts` goes from 22,517 to 22,423 lines, **net -94** (66 added, 160 removed). The module is 295 lines. With the two path readers below, the diff against `origin/main` is 527 changed lines over 4 files (+364 / -163).

### Readers of the moved lines

- **No reader of the moved bodies needed a change.** No `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `docs/qa/**`, `content/**` or `scripts/**` names a moved member (ADR-0104's pointer names `isFileReferencesMigrationVerified`, which stays). The prose that names them (`check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` comments, test headers, `sql-driver.ts`, `seed-tenancy-backfill.ts`, `packages/spec/src/contracts/objectql-engine.ts`) still resolves, because the methods stay on the class. No ADR anchor paragraph describes a moved body. No moved body reads `isSystem` (the two `{ isSystem: true }` literals are context construction, not reads; `check-system-context-census` passes unchanged at 153 read sites), holds a `query-options/no-any-erasure` site (8 at base and head), a tenant-audit untyped receiver, a `.canReadObject(` or `referenceTargetOf(` call (the two core census pins), or a `new Error(`. `isMissingTableError` keeps its two-argument form (`driver-error-classification.callers.test.ts`).
- **Decision-letter count:** `check-adr-anchors` at base `756220c4a` (clean detached worktree): 91 anchored files, **1,877** decision-letter citations, 59,318 resolving citations across 8,374 files. At head `c7df09f88`: 91, **1,877**, 59,321 across 8,375. No moved body comment cites a decision letter, and the module is not anchored, so the count is equal.

### Fold-ins (stale path readers of cut 12)

- `engine-realtime-publish.ts`'s header said `accessibleOrganizationsOf` stays in `engine.ts`; cut 12 moved it to `engine-driver-options.ts`. The sentence now says so (two comment lines).
- `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__engine-execute-transactions.ts.json` (cut 7) still carried the transaction-seam paragraph's `buildDriverOptions` half, which `engine-driver-options.ts`'s entry has carried since cut 12. That half now has one home, with `buildDriverOptions`' body: this entry's invariant is now the `engine.ts` entry's text exactly (the opening sentence, the `enforceTransactionOrigin` sentences and the "Never add a companion transaction" clause), with its file and three ids unchanged. The count above includes this edit.

<details><summary>Late-binding probe for the setter (one-off, not committed)</summary>

## Acceptance notes

- **Serial check**, re-read at 01:58Z (31 open PRs): three touch `packages/objectql/**`. #26337 (ADR-0142 phase 2, head `e45133760`) edits `engine.ts` in nine hunks (an import near line 245, three declarations above the class, and the `insert` / `update` bodies); none is in the moved section, on the import lines this cut edits, or on `MigrationFlagRead`. `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head with its head merges cleanly (exit 0). Under the card's rule 4 whichever lands second merges `main`. #26378 edits `packages/objectql/README.md` only; #26138 edits `validation/rule-validator.test.ts` only. No open PR touches `engine-realtime-publish.ts` or `scripts/adr-anchors/`.
- **Receiver notes, not a change in what runs:** `supplyTenantKeyCertifiedResolver` hands the driver `() => this.isOrganizationOwnershipCertified()`; `this` is now the host, whose member is a late-bound closure over the engine, so the call still lands on the engine's method (the probe sets a double after the hand-over and the resolver reaches it). `this.findOne(...)` keeps the engine as its receiver through the closure. `this._registry.getObject(...)`, `this.drivers.values()`, `this.admittedValueShapeViolations.get/set(...)` and `this.logger.info(...)` keep their own receivers.
- **Next cut from this screen:** re-measured on this head, Migration flags pays nothing further (six short bodies, 22 lines). Readable-ids security and permission/formula resolution pays about -87 with six bodies (three more stay on shared module helpers) and is the hottest section in the file; the rest pay -30 or less.

## Verification

At `c7df09f88`:

- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 64 families on the real diff. Every one was run, each exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`: 64 accounted for, 63 run green, 1 **NOT MEASURED** (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET; CI runs it): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package's `dist/`). Two first answered a shallow-clone prerequisite and were re-run green after `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-22 origin main`: `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`. Named readings: `check:adr-anchors` OK, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-engine-split-ratio --self-test`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check-affected-docs`, all exit 0.
